title: Add serial number field to staff management

requirements.summary: Display the serial number column in the staff management table, showing each staff member's assigned serial number
acceptanceCriteria: Serial number column is visible in the staff table
Serial numbers are displayed in ascending order
The column appears before or after the name column for easy reference

file_operations.description: Add a serial number column to the staff table display. Insert the column as the first column before the name field. Retrieve the serialNumber field from the Staff type (defined in backend.d.ts as bigint). Display serial numbers in ascending order by sorting staff members by their serialNumber field. Ensure the column header is labeled 'Serial No.' or 'S/N' for clarity. Verify the component's usage of the backend interface before implementing.

requirements.summary: When adding a new staff member, automatically assign the next available serial number without requiring manual input
acceptanceCriteria: The add staff form does not show a serial number input field
Serial numbers are assigned automatically by the backend
New staff members receive sequential serial numbers

file_operations.description: Remove any serial number input field from the add staff form if present. Ensure the form only collects name, Principal ID, role, and commission rate. The backend's addStaffMember method (defined in backend.d.ts) will automatically assign serial numbers, so no frontend changes are needed for serial number assignment logic. Update any form validation or submission logic to exclude serial number handling. Verify the component's usage of the backend interface before implementing.
